license_required.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

issuing_authority.quote: The board of registration in optometry, herein and in sections sixty-eight to seventy-three, inclusive, called the board

name.quote: The board of registration in optometry

type.quote: The board of registration in optometry, herein and in sections sixty-eight to seventy-three, inclusive, called the board

age_minimum.quote: he is eighteen years of age or older

degree_required.value: graduation from a school or college of optometry approved by the board, maintaining a course of study of not less than two years with a minimum requirement of fifteen hundred attendance hours or in the case of a person applying for a first examination after January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-five, maintaining a course of study of not less than three separate academic years, each academic year consisting of thirty-six weeks of classroom work with thirty hours of instruction each week
degree_required.quote: he has graduated from a school or college of optometry, approved by the board, maintaining a course of study of not less than two years with a minimum requirement of fifteen hundred attendance hours or in the case of a person applying for a first examination after January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-five, maintaining a course of study of not less than three separate academic years, each academic year consisting of thirty-six weeks of classroom work with thirty hours of instruction each week

exams.name: Board examination in theoretic, practical and physiological optics, theoretic and practical optometry, anatomy and physiology of the eye
exams.quote: shall have passed an examination conducted by the board in theoretic, practical and physiological optics, in theoretic and practical optometry and in the anatomy and physiology of the eye

exams.name: Examination for use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
exams.jurisdiction: state (in-house) or National Board of Examiners in Optometry
exams.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized in section 66C

required.quote: As a condition of license renewal, an optometrist licensed under this section shall submit to the board of registration in optometry evidence attesting to the completion of 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

hours_per_period.quote: 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

topical_requirements.quote: 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

available.quote: Any person who shall present to the board a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in optometry in any other state, where the requirements for registration are in the opinion of the board equivalent to those of this commonwealth, may be registered and given a certificate of registration in this commonwealth without a written examination

requirements.value: Requirements for reciprocity: (1) the other state must accord a like privilege to Massachusetts certificate holders; (2) the applicant must not have previously failed the Massachusetts examination; (3) the applicant must have been engaged in reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding application; (4) the applicant must intend to reside and practice optometry in Massachusetts
requirements.quote: provided, that such state accords a like privilege to holders of certificates of registration issued in this commonwealth, and that the applicant has not previously failed to pass the examination required in this commonwealth, and that he has been engaged in the reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding his application, and that he intends to reside and practice optometry in this commonwealth

exists.quote: The board of registration in optometry, herein and in sections sixty-eight to seventy-three, inclusive, called the board, shall keep a record of the names of all persons examined and registered by it

national_certification.value: National Board of Examiners in Optometry
national_certification.quote: include any portion of the examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or other appropriate examination covering the subject matter of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

national_association.quote: A licensed optometrist who has completed a postgraduate residency program approved by the Accreditation Council on Optometric Education of the American Optometric Association

regulatory_model.quote: a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in optometry in any other state

credential_type.quote: shall have been registered and shall have received a certificate of registration which shall have conspicuously printed on its face the definition of optometry set forth in section sixty-six

is_mandatory.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

title_protection.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice optometry, practices optometry, or holds himself out as a practitioner of, or as being able to practice, optometry

scope_protection.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice optometry, practices optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in making application or taking an examination for registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may refuse to grant a certificate of registration to any applicant found guilty of fraud in making application or taking an examination for registration
The board may revoke or suspend any certificate of registration for unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in practice or in advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in practice or in advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual drunkenness for six months immediately before the charges are made
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for habitual drunkenness for six months immediately before the charges are made

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule or regulation made under section sixty-seven
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or for violation of any rule or regulation made under section sixty-seven

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision

value: prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses
methods_authorized.quote: by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures

drug_authority.value: topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B that are used in the practice of optometry, including those placed in schedules III, IV, V and VI
drug_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B that are used in the practice of optometry, including those placed in schedules III, IV, V and VI

surgery_prohibited.quote: a registered optometrist shall not use or prescribe: (A) therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of systemic diseases; (B) invasive surgical procedures

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: for the purpose of diagnosing, preventing, correcting, managing or treating glaucoma and other ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: cardiopulmonary resuscitation, including treatment of anaphylaxis: four hours

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: a registered optometrist shall not use or prescribe: (A) therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of systemic diseases; (B) invasive surgical procedures; (C) pharmaceutical agents administered by subdermal injection, intramuscular injection, intravenous injection, subcutaneous injection, intraocular injection or retrobulbar injection; or (D) an opioid substance or drug product

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: certified under section 68C and registered to issue written prescriptions pursuant to subsection (h) of section 7 of chapter 94C

dea_registration_required.quote: registered to issue written prescriptions pursuant to subsection (h) of section 7 of chapter 94C

value: Certificate of qualification in the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
specialty_certification_types.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall provide to each successful applicant a certificate of qualification in the use and prescription of all therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized under said section 66C

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: this course of study shall include ninety-five hours of study in the following areas: (A) general pharmacology: four hours in biochemistry; eight hours in general physiology, two of which shall be in pediatric physiology; eight hours in pharmacology, three of which shall be in pediatric pharmacology; and ten hours in indications and ocular effects of commonly prescribed drugs, two of which shall be in indications of effects in pediatric situations; (B) ocular pharmacology: eight hours in ocular pharmacology and eight hours in the study of particular topically applied agents

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: supervised clinical practice, including six hours in pediatric practice: thirty hours

referral_to_physician_required.quote: If an optometrist, while examining or treating a patient with the aid of a diagnostic or therapeutic pharmaceutical agent and exercising professional judgment and the degree of expertise, care and knowledge ordinarily possessed and exercised by optometrists under like circumstances, encounters a sign of a previously unevaluated disease that would require treatment not included in the scope of the practice of optometry, the optometrist shall refer the patient to a licensed physician or other qualified health care practitioner

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: If an optometrist diagnoses a patient with congenital glaucoma or if, during the course of examining, managing or treating a patient with glaucoma, the optometrist determines that surgical treatment is indicated, the optometrist shall refer the patient to a qualified health care provider for treatment

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: An optometrist licensed under this chapter shall participate in any relevant state or federal report or data collection effort relative to patient safety and medical error reduction coordinated by the Betsy Lehman center for patient safety and medical error reduction established in section 15 of chapter 12C
